title: Myopia Nearsightedness Correction Concave Lens
definition: Myopia (nearsightedness) is a refractive error of the eye where distant objects appear blurred because light rays converge in front of the retina, correctable using a diverging concave lens.
importanceInUpsc: Tested in UPSC CSE Prelims (GS-1 Science & Tech) regarding optics principles, physics of lens types, and human eye disorders, alongside public health implications like rising myopia rates among youth.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Myopia Nearsightedness Correction Concave Lens.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Power of lenses and focal length sign conventions
